title: 周末去公园
topicEn: A weekend trip to the park

explanations.2: Indicates that the action is done together.
explanations.4: Describes a large quantity of flowers.
explanations.5: Refers to the body of water in the park.
explanations.6: Question word for an unspecified number of ducks.
explanations.7: Modal verb indicating ability to take photos.
explanations.8: Verb meaning to take a photo.
explanations.9: Noun referring to the pictures taken.
explanations.11: Verb describing the action of resting.
explanations.12: Number indicating one piece of lawn.
explanations.13: Measure word for a piece of land.
explanations.14: Preposition indicating location where eating happened.
explanations.15: Verb describing the action of having lunch.

translation: Today is the weekend. I and my friend go to the park together. There are many flowers inside the park. On the lake there are a few ducks. My friend can take photos. He takes many photos. Then we go to a tree behind which we rest. Behind the tree there is a piece of lawn. I eat lunch there. I bring two pieces of bread and a bottle of water. My friend brings fruit. We play until the afternoon. Then we go home together. Today is really happy.
